title: Introduction
text: lagdynamics implements lag-sequential analysis (LSA) network representation, lag transition network, categorical event sequence data. LSA classical inferential method temporal contingency observed behaviour: tests, every ordered pair states, whether one state follows another less often independence predicts (Sackett, 1979; Bakeman & Gottman, 1997). package restates method modern statistical workflow built six commitments: Tidy. Every result produced verb – transitions(), nodes(), tests(), initial(), summary(), transition_probabilities(), .data.frame() – returns one-row-per-observation data frame. Filters arguments (significant = TRUE, direction = "", min_count =), never subsetting; user never indexes object. Confirmatory, following Dynalytics. package operationalizes Dynalytics framework (Saqr, Lopez-Pernas, & Misiejuk, 2026), whose central tenet scientific contract: every analytical claim matched evidence appropriate structure, scope, complexity. Validation therefore expanded far beyond classical residual test full battery – analytic Bayesian certainty, sequence-level bootstrap, split-half reliability, case-drop stability, within-sequence permutation null. Number label permutations per comparison. Default 1000. measure Character. per-edge quantity compared groups. Default "log_or": per-cell log odds ratio 2x2 transition collapse (Haldane-Anscombe corrected empty cells) – N-invariant LSA effect size, comparison reflects behaviour rather sample size. options: "yules_q" (also N-invariant, saturates +/-1 zero cells), "adj_res" (adjusted residuals – LSA test statistic, scales sqrt(N) therefore confounded group size; message warns groups differ size), "prob" (transition probabilities – raw rate, .e. Rarer cells carry unstable odds ratio near-degenerate permutation null produces spurious small p-values, get p = NA excluded multiple-comparison family omnibus rather flagged significant. what: Directed transfer entropy for categorical sequences (experimental) — transfer_entropy
title: Directed transfer entropy for categorical sequences (experimental) — transfer_entropy
text: Experimental. Transfer entropy (Schreiber, 2000) measures directed predictive coupling: much knowing source's past reduces uncertainty target's future, beyond target's past already explains. conditions target's history, transfer entropy immune autocorrelation confound inflates plain lagged association process strong momentum. Unlike lsa()'s Yule's Q / adjusted residuals, transfer entropy sign-blind: large value means "strong directed predictive structure", may facilitating suppressing. Read alongside signed measures transitions() interpret direction effect. Two modes: State-flow network (default, y = NULL): given categorical sequences, returns directed transfer entropy every ordered pair states, via binary occupancy decomposition. Note: states non-target source channels become redundant; prefer bivariate mode larger alphabet matters. Bivariate (y supplied): full-alphabet transfer entropy two aligned categorical series, directions.
